required_gates.detail: Concrete proposed orientation plus existing Foundations certificate mapping is prepared, but no exact course mapping or legacy formula decision is approved.
Existing professional-course reviews, verification and capstone requirements remain in force. No signoffs or qualified reviewer identities are invented.
No existing isolated Supabase branch. Real coach/client/admin sign-in, consent, scheduling and sharing-revocation acceptance remain unexecuted.
No actual iPhone/Safari or complete screen-reader acceptance of the new code.
210 review drafts across seven non-Recovery programs; no publication or claim of full multi-year parity.
Program-specific tools, including multi-person care records and their consolidated dashboard, need acceptance evidence. Content prompts alone are not feature implementation.
Separate final rollout approval follows completed prerequisite evidence. Marketplace and payments remain off.

phased_release_rule: An individually ready program may release after its own applicable gates pass; the approved eight-program portfolio and 1+20 roadmap are unchanged.
